limitations.note: With WAVE_MAX set to 20, the square-wave counter still wraps at 20 instead of 19, leaving a 21-clock period instead of the intended 20-clock period.

The rewrite forces the square output low on entry instead of holding the previous sample until a threshold, and changes the triangle's reset and mode-entry sequence instead of just correcting its upper turnaround.
The test hard-coded the patch's incorrect 21-clock square period and its new reset and mode-switch behavior, so passing reinforced those assumptions rather than detecting the mismatch.
